cli.help:
Scriptura {version}

Usage: scriptura <command> [--json]

Settings and operations:
  enable --repo <path> --accept-consent <version> [--mode propose|push|off] [--branches a,b] [--documents AGENTS.md,README.md]
                                    Enable document maintenance for a repository (default: propose)
  disable --repo <path>             Remove the registration
  pause [--repo <path>]             Pause maintenance
  resume [--repo <path>]            Resume maintenance
  status                            Show settings, registrations and proposal counts
  doctor [--verify]                 Diagnose the environment and settings
  run-now [--repo <path>] [--documents a,b]
                                    Run maintenance once now (--documents limits the kinds processed)
  docs list [--repo <path>]         List the settings and state of document kinds (built-in and custom)
  docs show <id> [--repo <path>]    Show the settings of one document kind in detail
  ui [--port <n>] [--no-open]       Open the management screen in a browser (127.0.0.1 only; default port 7468)
  ui --tray                         Keep the management screen in the system tray / menu bar (ui --autostart on|off toggles starting it at logon; Setup edition only)

Proposals (propose mode):
  review [sha|latest] [--repo <path>]   Review a proposal
  apply [sha|latest] [--repo <path>]    Apply a proposal to the working tree (does not stage)
  discard [sha|latest] [--repo <path>]  Discard a proposal

Installation and integration:
  hook                              Run as the Claude Code Stop hook (reads JSON from stdin)
  install                           Copy this executable to the per-user install location
  connect claude-code [--apply]     Register the Stop hook in settings.json (preview until --apply)
  connect claude-code --remove [--apply]  Remove only the Scriptura Stop hook

Setup edition (automatic updates):
  update [--check] [--auto on|off]  Show the automatic update status (--check checks and downloads now, --auto turns it ON/OFF)
  update-apply                      Apply a downloaded update (started automatically at sign-in; skipped while another Scriptura is running)
  uninstall-setup [--apply]         Remove the Setup edition registrations (Stop hook and apply-at-sign-in) (preview until --apply)

With --json, a single machine-readable JSON object is printed.
